title: 第1章 开局穿越发现宗门大师兄是她弟第2章 身体比脑子反应更快
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
“夏以苜，你毁我紫云宗至宝碧落兰，你可知罪？”
“罚你剑刑十道、挖去灵根！”
威严愤怒的声音传入夏以苜的耳朵，周围是嘈杂的人声，吵得她头疼。
她在寻找植物种子的路上遇到泥石流。
前一秒还在泥石流中挣扎，感叹这些年她养大的弟弟一个接一个离世，命运那把杀猪刀终于还是落到了她的头上。
后一秒她就穿越到了这个鬼地方。
巨大的广场上，她被关在铁笼里，放在正中央。
周围是一群身着统一服饰的宗门弟子，以及数十名长老。
很显然，她穿越到修真界了，穿到了一个十六岁的凡人少女身上。
原主叫夏以苜，比她的名字多了个“以”字。
夏以苜还没来得及庆祝自己劫后余生，便听到先前那道声音继续宣布道：
“即刻行刑！”
夏以苜一双眼睛倏然睁大。
行刑？
余光瞥见铁笼旁那长老手里握着的剑，剑刃上闪着恐怖的寒光。
光是看一眼便能想象到它落在身上，轻易划开皮肉的模样。
另一长老手里拿着一把特制的匕首，对应着那句挖去灵根。
而这两样东西，马上就要落在她的身上，夏以苜直接两眼一黑。
要死！
她这是造什么孽了，用得着如此大刑伺候！

周围的弟子们义愤填膺。
“那可是碧落兰啊，修真界几百年来就那么一株，偏偏被你个凡人给毁了！”
“我们紫云宗好心收买你们村的灵植，没想到来送灵植的人手脚这般不干净！”
“就你还痴心妄想加入宗门，就应该挖了你的灵根！”
夏以苜刚想说，若是她重新种出碧落兰，能不能暂且放她一马。
即便这里是修真界，身为24世纪最有天赋的植物学专家，她不信她种不出那什么碧落兰。
这时迟来的记忆终于如潮水一般涌入她的脑海。
本来这样被指着鼻子骂就烦，更让夏以苜不能接受的是。
她是被！冤！枉！的！
记忆里，原主出现在种植碧落兰的灵田旁边的时候，碧落兰便已经凋亡。
原主脑子似乎不太清醒，其他细节她想不起来。
content_en:
"Xia Yilu, you destroyed the Biluo Lan, the most precious treasure of my Ziyun Sect, do you know your guilt?"
"I will punish you with ten strokes of the sword and have your spiritual roots dug out!"
The majestic and angry voice reached Xia Yilu's ears, and the noise around her gave her a headache.
She encountered a mudslide while searching for plant seeds.
One second she was still struggling in the mudslide, lamenting that the brothers she had raised had passed away one after another over the years, and that the butcher's knife of fate had finally fallen on her head.
The next second she traveled to this ghost place.
In the huge square, she was locked in an iron cage and placed in the center.
Surrounded by a group of sect disciples in uniform uniforms and dozens of elders.
Obviously, she traveled to the world of cultivation and passed through the body of a sixteen-year-old mortal girl.
The original owner's name was Xia Yilu, which had an extra "Yi" character in her name.
Before Xia Yihuo had time to celebrate his survival, he heard the previous voice continue to announce:
"Execution immediately!"
Xia Yilu's eyes suddenly widened.
Execution?
Out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of the sword held by the elder beside the iron cage, with a terrifying cold light shining on the blade.
Just by looking at it, you can imagine how it would fall on your body and easily cut through your skin.
Another elder held a special dagger in his hand, corresponding to the sentence of digging out the spiritual roots.
These two things were about to fall on her body, and Xia Yilu's eyes darkened.
To die!
What kind of sin has she committed to deserve such a severe punishment!
The disciples around him were filled with indignation.
"That's the Blue Orchid. There's only been one in the world of cultivation for hundreds of years, and it was destroyed by you, a mortal!"
"Our Ziyun Sect kindly bought the spiritual plants from your village, but we didn't expect that the person who came to give them away had such unclean hands and feet!"
"Just because you still want to join the sect, I should dig up your spiritual roots!"
Xia Yiyi was just about to say, if she could plant Biluolan again, could she be let go for the time being?
Even though this was the world of cultivation, as the most talented botany expert in the 24th century, she didn't believe that she couldn't grow that blue orchid.
At this moment, belated memories finally flooded into her mind.
It was annoying to be pointed at and scolded like this, but what Xia Yihuo couldn't accept was even more.
She is being! injustice! in vain! of!
In memory, when the original owner appeared next to the spiritual field where Biluolan was planted, Biluolan had already died.
The original owner didn't seem to be very clear-headed, and she couldn't remember other details.
